# CodeEraser's built-in prelude (plan v2.31 step 2, design booklet
# §4.3): the rules every program starts with. Their predicates are
# reserved — a program that redefines one is a program error (7).
# `dead` mirrors `ce deadcode`'s file-tier verdict: an entry is a node
# with any role bit (every role lands in the core's entry mask), and a
# reference of any rung is followed except the two liveness-inert
# kinds (asset, refdef) the graph judgment drops the same way.
entry(N) :- role(N, _).
reach(N) :- entry(N).
reach(M) :- reach(N), ref(N, M, K, _), K != asset, K != refdef.
dead(F) :- file(F), not reach(F).
depends(N, M) :- ref(N, M, _, _).
depends(N, M) :- depends(N, K), ref(K, M, _, _).
same_dir(F, G) :- in_dir(F, D), in_dir(G, D), F != G.
dir_ref(D, E) :- ref(F, G, _, _), in_dir(F, D), in_dir(G, E), D != E.

# [rules.pack] no_dir_cycles = true
pack_dir_reach(D, E) :- dir_ref(D, E).
pack_dir_reach(D, F) :- pack_dir_reach(D, E), dir_ref(E, F).
assert pack_no_dir_cycles(D, E) :- pack_dir_reach(D, E), pack_dir_reach(E, D), D < E.
# [rules.pack] fan_in_max = 0
assert pack_fan_in_max(G, N) :- file(G), N = count(F : ref(F, G, _, _), file(F), F != G), N > 0.
# [rules.pack] fan_out_max = 0
assert pack_fan_out_max(F, N) :- file(F), N = count(G : ref(F, G, _, _), file(G), F != G), N > 0.
# [rules.pack] layers = ["b/**", "a/**"]
assert pack_layers_1_0(F, G) :- in(F, "a/**"), ref(F, G, _, _), in(G, "b/**").
# [rules.pack] forbid ["a/**", "b/**"]
assert pack_forbid_0(F, G) :- in(F, "a/**"), ref(F, G, _, _), in(G, "b/**").
